description: Jedox Planning Visual for Power BI Introducing the Jedox Planning Visual for Power BI, a powerful tool that seamlessly integrates Jedox's advanced planning and analytics capabilities into your Power BI environment. Leveraging Jedox Dynatables, this visual empowers users to create dynamic, on-the-fly reports and writeback to your Jedox Databases & Cubes. Key Features: Seamless authentication with Single Sign-On, connect to Jedox using your Microsoft account, ensuring scalability and easy deployment for large enterprises while maintaining security standards Create or access your stored Dynatables to enhance your Power BI dashboards. By adding Jedox Dynatables directly into Power BI, users can seamlessly combine multiple data sources in one place, facilitating insight generation Planning capabilities, this visual allows users to input data directly into the Jedox database from within Power BI. The writeback functionality ensures that your data remains updated, streamlining planning and forecasting processes Enhanced Collaboration, by integrating Jedox's planning features into Power BI, organizations can unify their reporting and planning activities, reducing reliance on other tools and promoting a more optimal workflow Benefits: Streamlined Workflow: Eliminate the need to switch between multiple applications. Analyze, plan, and update your data all within the Power BI interface.…
keywords: Jedox Planning Visual for Power BI
